logic.entry: While cash, prior completed close strictly > mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1+band).
logic.exit: While long, prior completed close strictly < mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1-band). Equality/deadband preserves state.
logic.sizing: All available component cash buys spot at next 00:01 UTC minute open, after costs; no leverage, borrowing, periodic rebalance or transfers. USDT yield=0.

costs.impact: 0.5 * strictly previous20completedUTCdays sample log-close volatility * sqrt(reference order upper-bound cash budget or sell reference notional / previous20day quote ADV)
costs.funding_borrow: Not applicable to unlevered long-only spot; no spot short or borrow.
costs.execution_limitations: Reuse existing daily floating-quantity accounting; no historical L2, tick/lot/min-notional or minute capacity calibration. Daily close NAV does not include full intraday drawdown.

parameters.observation_terminal_action: Mark only; no artificial liquidation; preserve units/cash for continuing frozen plan
parameters.qualification: Partial shadow snapshot; minimum180days not reached; no long-run pass/fail inference
